main_text.p: μαι. a.1.med. κοψάμλω ω ἀ̃ς prat.med.κέ- κοπα, hinc κόπος labor, κοπὴ strages, κοπὶς ἰδὸς ἡ culter, &c.
Κοράσιον ν τὸ puella, ἀ κόρ@ ν ὁ juvenculus. κόρη ης ἡ puella.item pupilla in oculo. Th. κορέω verro, purgo.
Κορβανᾶν Syriace, κορβᾶν Hebraice, oblatio, a radice karabh appropinquavit. hikribh obtulit.
Κορέννυμι faturo. Fut. κορέσω. P. κεκόρεσμα. praf. paff. κορέννυμαι fatuor. prat.paff. κεκόρεσμαι. a.1.paff. ἐκορέσθην.
Κόρ@ ν ὁ corus, nomen mensura aridorum, Luc.16.7.
Κοσμέω ῶ orno. Fut. κοσμῶ. P. κεκόσμημαι. aor.1. ἐκόσμησα adornavi, praparavi. prat. paff. κεκοσμημαι.
Κόσμος ν ὁ mundus. item ornatus muliebris, qui Latine quoq; mundus dicitur.
Κοσμικὸς ἡ ὀν mundanus a um. in bonam partem accipitur Heb.9.1. in malam partem, Tit.2.12.
Κοσμιΐ@ ν ὁ ἡ bene compositus a.

Κοσμοκράτωρ ὁ princeps mundi. h. e. reproborum. Sic dicitur Satanas, Eph.6.12. qui etiam vocatur ὁ τῆς σκοτίας τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου Joh. 16.11.compof.ex κόσμος ν ὁ, & κρατέω ῶ imperium obtineo. Them.κράτος ν τὸ robur.

page.notes: Right margin notes are fragmentary and largely illegible due to the scan edge; they were not transcribed in full. Greek text is transcribed from the scan with several letters doubtful; accents and breathings may be imperfect. Marginal fragments include references such as "Marc.5.41", "Joh.", "Luc.", "Mat." and Greek words, but could not be read reliably.
